about: One list of user scenarios that BOTH apps must pass with the same test ids. Compose: composeApp/src/jvmTest/.../ScenarioTest.kt, a test function per id. iOS: iosApp/UITests/ScenarioTests.swift, func test_<id>(). Both start the demo robot with the same words (shared app/AppStart.kt). scenarios/check.py fails CI when an app misses one.

scenarios.steps: welcome > get started > scan finds 2 demo robots > pick the first > next > PIN 4321 > test connection > connected > done > home
welcome > get started > pick the first robot > next > PIN 0000 > test connection > 'that failed' with the PIN help
home shows 'not connected yet' > tap the state pill > planning On, next run 21:00, battery 13.5 V
tap route A > dry run > result 'dry run OK' with 'start for real' and 'close' > start for real goes back to the slider
tap route B > slide to start > 'route started' > done closes the sheet > card says last started today
tap route A > slide > 'robot busy' warning with only 'close'
refresh > tap planning > confirm > planning Off
open the robot's panel > connect > display shows the robot's home screen > press Enter > the display text changes (the menu opens; with planning on the robot ignores Enter) > back disconnects
settings > language > English > the screen title is 'Settings'
home > edit > rename route A to 'Feed alley' > hide route D > back > home shows 'Feed alley' and no route D
home > edit > read routes > route C shows its sub-routes '1 2 3' (read from the robot's route menu, nothing started)
settings > add robot > scan finds the second demo robot > name 'Barn 2', PIN 4321 > add > home shows 'Barn 2' and '2 robots'
dry run route A > settings > logbook shows it > clear > empty
